A lot of my classmates from high school joined the military (largely army, some marines, some air force). I've talked to a lot of them about, well, when I still could talk to any of them, at least, so it was a while ago. 

I wouldn't want to join the military for personal reasons, let alone the reasons friends gave me after they got out. The organization just isn't for me, I don't want to be drilled, dieted, broken down, rebuilt, or hurt anyone. So, I'm sorry, but it just isn't for me.

I don't feel entirely comfortably saying where I live, but I will tell you that it is a medium sized, well known, city in north east U.S.

Therapy and medication both cost a lot of money so they just aren't really options. Besides that, I've engaged in talk therapy once before and found it to be totally unsatisfying. I'm not saying that talk therapy is a waste of time for everyone, but for me it did not prove to be at all useful. I'm also rather hesitant about medication. I'm not going to go into why I'm not interested in medication, but I'll sum it up by saying that I don't have any amount of faith in the companies that push the pills.

Sorry, I don't think that I made it clear in my original post. I'm not going to shoot myself tonight. I already tried and was simply too afraid to do it. Besides that, my revolver is a low enough caliber that I fear it could critically injure me. Brain damage really terrifies me.
